screensaver.name: longafterdark
screensaver._description:
Long After Dark brings back the original Berkeley Systems After Dark screen savers from the 1990s (Flying Toasters, Boris, Simpsons, and more), running original modules under x86 emulation on modern Linux.
Caps Lock starts interactive games (e.g. Rodger Dodger, Trivia).
https://github.com/hardwarebob/longafterdark
